patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge. Choose Grasshopper only if your buying job matches “SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (f” rather than Cisco Webex's shape. Choose Cisco Webex only if your buying job matches “Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Ca” rather than Grasshopper's shape. Workflow advantage: Grasshopper leans shared coverage; Cisco Webex leans team-communication, contact-center. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Grasshopper is SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (flat account, not per seat).; Cisco Webex is Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Calling and Contact Center often quote-layered..
- Company-size focus: Grasshopper (solo, small-business) vs Cisco Webex (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Grasshopper-leaning — vs Cisco Webex-leaning team-communication, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Grasshopper — Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); Cisco Webex — Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic.

Limitations — Grasshopper: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above; Cisco Webex: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors.

Poor-fit cases: Grasshopper is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) · Cisco Webex is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic · Avoid Grasshopper if you actually need Cisco Webex's motion (Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
